front.title: PSI-09: Receipts for Age Assurance Decisions

abstract.t:
This document defines PSI-09, a domain profile of Proof of Stateful Integrity (PSI) for decisions made by an age assurance provider, recording that a check was performed, by which method, and with what outcome. Each record is sealed as a PSI receipt so that later alteration, reordering, or removal is detectable. Only digests are sealed. PSI-09 shows integrity and ordering only; it does not show the age of any person, the accuracy of the method, or compliance with any age assurance law.
Revision 00 carried this title over an abstract describing tribunal verdicts. That material is withdrawn and this revision makes the body match the title.
